title: Handle an employee grievance
summary: When a worker raises a workplace concern outside the immediate safety or harassment-response route. A confidential documented outcome with an impartial review route and tracked corrective actions.
outcomes: A confidential documented outcome with an impartial review route and tracked corrective actions.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a worker raises a workplace concern outside the immediate safety or harassment-response route.

parts.title: Record the concern and preserve relevant evidence
parts.guidance: Capture the employee's account, requested outcome and any immediate safety or retaliation concerns. Restrict access and route urgent safety, harassment or criminal concerns to the appropriate specialist response.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Choose an impartial and applicable process
parts.guidance: HR or the designated reviewer confirms conflicts, local requirements, representation and policy steps. Explain who will handle the concern and distinguish an informal discussion from a formal investigation.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Choose an impartial and applicable process

parts.title: Hear the parties and investigate the facts
parts.guidance: The appointed reviewer gathers relevant accounts and documents fairly, giving people an appropriate opportunity to respond. Protect confidentiality without promising secrecy that prevents a proper review.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Hear the parties and investigate the facts

parts.title: Review and communicate the decision
parts.guidance: The authorized decision maker evaluates findings, proposed remedies and employment-law advice. Communicate the approved outcome and applicable review or appeal route, limiting disclosure of other people's personal information.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Track remedies and protect against recurrence
parts.guidance: Record action owners, dates and follow-up with the affected employee. Check for retaliation and recurring issues and retain the case evidence under the approved retention and access rules.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.
